units.en: Yelu Hanba, Yelu Tanggu, and Xiao Paizhe
units.literal: Yelu Hanba, Yelu Tanggu, Xiao Paizhe

units.zh: 〈（藥師奴）〉
units.en: (Yaoshinu)
units.literal: (Yaoshinu)

units.zh: 耶律玦 耶律仆里篤
units.en: Yelu Jue and Yelu Pulidu
units.literal: Yelu Jue, Yelu Pulidu

units.zh: 耶律韓八
units.en: Yelu Hanba
units.literal: Yelu Hanba

units.zh: 耶律韓八，字嘲隱，倜儻有大志，北院詳穩古之五世孫。
units.en: Yelu Hanba, style name Chaoyin, was dashing and ambitious, a fifth-generation descendant of Gu, Details Steady of the Northern Court.
units.literal: Yelu Hanba, whose style name was Chaoyin, was unconventionally talented and had great ambitions; he was the fifth-generation descendant of Gu, Details Steady of the Northern Court.

units.zh: 太平中，遊京師，寓行宮側，惟囊衣匹馬而已。
units.en: During the Taiping reign, he came to the capital and lodged by the traveling palace with nothing but a bag of clothes and one horse.
units.literal: During the Taiping era, he traveled to the capital, lodged beside the traveling palace, and had only a bag of clothes and a single horse.

units.zh: 帝微服出獵，見而問之曰：「汝為何人？」
units.en: The emperor went out hunting in disguise, saw him, and asked, "Who are you?"
units.literal: The emperor went hunting in plain clothes, saw him, and asked: "Who are you?"

units.zh: 韓八初不識，漫應曰：「我北院部人韓八，來覓官耳。」
units.en: Hanba did not recognize him at first and answered offhandedly, "I am Hanba of the Northern Court tribes, here to seek an appointment."
units.literal: Hanba did not recognize him at first and answered casually: "I am Hanba of the Northern Court tribes, here to seek an office."

units.zh: 帝與語，知有長才，陰識之。
units.en: After speaking with him, the emperor perceived his great ability and marked him in secret.
units.literal: After conversing with him, the emperor recognized his great talent and took note of him privately.

units.zh: 會北院奏南京疑獄久不決，帝召韓八馳驛審錄，舉朝皆驚。
units.en: When the Northern Court reported that a doubtful case at Nanjing had long remained unsettled, the emperor summoned Hanba to ride post-haste and examine the records, and the whole court was astonished.
units.literal: When the Northern Court reported that a doubtful case at Nanjing had long gone unresolved, the emperor summoned Hanba to ride post-haste and review the records; the whole court was astonished.

units.zh: 韓八量情處理，人無冤者。
units.en: Hanba judged each case on its merits, and no one was wrongfully convicted.
units.literal: Hanba handled matters according to circumstances; no one suffered wrongful conviction.

units.zh: 上嘉之。
units.en: The emperor commended him.
units.literal: The emperor praised him.

units.zh: 籍群牧馬，闕其二，同事者考尋不已，韓八略不加詰，即先馳奏，帝益信任。
units.en: When the collective herd horses were inventoried, two were missing; his colleagues kept investigating without end, but Hanba barely pressed the matter and first sent an urgent report to court, and the emperor trusted him all the more.
units.literal: When counting the collective herd horses, two were missing; his colleagues kept investigating without cease, but Hanba scarcely questioned further and first sent a hurried report; the emperor trusted him all the more.

units.zh: 景福元年，為左夷離畢，徙北面林牙，眷遇優異。
units.en: In the first year of the Jingfu era he was made Left Yilibi, transferred to Northern Forest Ya, and received exceptionally generous favor.
units.literal: In the first year of Jingfu he became Left Yilibi, was transferred to Northern Forest Ya, and received exceptionally favored treatment.

units.zh: 重熙六年，改北院大王，政務寬仁，復為左夷離畢。
units.en: In the sixth year of Chongxi he was made Great King of the Northern Court; his administration was lenient and humane, and he again became Left Yilibi.
units.literal: In the sixth year of Chongxi he was changed to Great King of the Northern Court; his governance was lenient and humane, and he again became Left Yilibi.

units.zh: 十二年，再為北院大王。
units.en: In the twelfth year he again became Great King of the Northern Court.
units.literal: In the twelfth year he again became Great King of the Northern Court.

units.zh: 入朝，帝從容謂曰：「卿守邊任重，當實府庫、振貧乏以報朕。」
units.en: When he came to court, the emperor said at ease, "You bear heavy responsibility on the frontier; you should fill the treasuries and relieve the poor to repay Us."
units.literal: On entering court, the emperor said at ease: "You bear heavy responsibility guarding the frontier; you should fill the treasuries and relieve the impoverished to repay Us."

units.zh: 既受詔，愈竭忠謹，知無不言，便益為多。
units.en: Once he received the edict, he became ever more utterly loyal and careful, spoke freely of whatever he knew, and his beneficial counsel was abundant.
units.literal: Once he received the edict, he became ever more utterly loyal and cautious, speaking of whatever he knew without reserve, and his perquisites grew numerous.

units.zh: 卒，年五十五。
units.en: He died at the age of fifty-five.
units.literal: He died at age fifty-five.

units.zh: 上聞，悼惜。
units.en: When the emperor heard of it, he mourned and grieved.
units.literal: On hearing of it, the emperor mourned and regretted his loss.

units.zh: 死之日，篋無舊蓄，椸無新衣，遣使吊祭，給葬具。
units.en: On the day of his death his chest held no old stores and his wardrobe no new clothes; the emperor sent envoys to mourn him and provide funeral goods.
units.literal: On the day of his death his chest held no old stores and his wardrobe no new clothes; the emperor sent envoys to mourn and provide funeral goods.

units.zh: 韓八平居不屑細務，喜慍不形。
units.en: In ordinary life Hanba disdained petty affairs and never let pleasure or anger show on his face.
units.literal: In ordinary life Hanba disdained petty affairs and never showed pleasure or anger on his face.

units.zh: 嘗失所乘馬，家僮以同色者代之，數月不覺。
units.en: Once he lost the horse he rode; a household servant replaced it with one of the same color, and for months he did not notice.
units.literal: Once he lost the horse he rode; a household servant substituted one of the same color, and for months he did not notice.

units.zh: 耶律唐古
units.en: Yelu Tanggu
units.literal: Yelu Tanggu

units.zh: 耶律唐古，字敵隱，於越屋質之庶子。
units.en: Yelu Tanggu, style name Diyi, was a son born to a concubine of Yuyue Wuzhi.
units.literal: Yelu Tanggu, whose style name was Diyi, was a concubine's son of Yuyue Wuzhi.

units.zh: 廉謹，善屬文。
units.en: He was upright and cautious, and skilled at literary composition.
units.literal: He was incorruptible, cautious, and skilled at composing texts.

units.zh: 統和二十四年，述屋質安民治盜之法以進，補小將軍，遷西南面巡檢，歷豪州刺史、唐古部詳穩。
units.en: In the twenty-fourth year of Tonghe he presented Wuzhi's methods for pacifying the people and controlling bandits, was appointed Junior General, transferred to Southwest Circuit Inspector, and successively served as prefect of Haozhou and Details Steady of the Tanggu tribe.
units.literal: In the twenty-fourth year of Tonghe he presented Wuzhi's methods for pacifying the people and controlling bandits, was appointed Junior General, transferred to Southwest Circuit Inspector, and successively served as Prefect of Haozhou and Details Steady of the Tanggu tribe.

units.zh: 嚴立科條，禁奸民鬻馬於宋、夏界。
units.en: He strictly established regulations forbidding unscrupulous commoners from selling horses to the Song and Xia borderlands.
units.literal: He strictly established regulations forbidding treacherous commoners from selling horses at the Song and Xia borders.

units.zh: 因陳弭私販安邊境之要。
units.en: He thereby set forth the essentials of ending private trade in order to secure the border.
units.literal: He thereby set forth the essentials of ending private trade to secure the borderlands.

units.zh: 太后嘉之，詔邊郡遵行，著為令。
units.en: The empress dowager commended this, ordered the border commanderies to follow it, and enacted it as statute.
units.literal: The empress dowager commended this and ordered border commanderies to follow it, enacting it as statute.

units.zh: 朝議欲廣西南封域，黑山之西，綿亙數千里，唐古言：「戍壘太遠，卒有警急，赴援不及，非良策也。」
units.en: The court debated expanding the southwestern frontier west of Black Mountain across thousands of li; Tanggu said, "If the garrisons are too far away, when sudden alarm arises relief cannot arrive in time — this is no sound policy."
units.literal: The court debated expanding the southwestern dominion west of Black Mountain across thousands of li; Tanggu said: "If garrisons are too distant, when sudden alarm arises, relief cannot arrive in time — this is no good policy."

units.zh: 從之。
units.en: The court accepted his view.
units.literal: The court accepted his view.

units.zh: 西番來侵，詔議守禦計，命唐古勸督耕稼以給西軍，田於臚朐河側，是歲大熟。
units.en: When western tribes invaded, an edict called for plans of defense; Tanggu was ordered to urge and supervise farming to supply the western army; fields were planted beside the Lujiong River, and that year brought a great harvest.
units.literal: When western tribes invaded, an edict called for defense plans; Tanggu was ordered to urge and supervise farming to supply the western army; fields were planted beside the Lujiong River and that year brought a great harvest.

units.zh: 明年，移屯鎮州，凡十四稔，積粟數十萬斛，斗米數錢。
units.en: The next year he moved the garrison to Zhenzhou; over fourteen harvests he accumulated several hundred thousand hu of grain, and rice sold for only a few cash per dou.
units.literal: The next year he moved the garrison to Zhenzhou; over fourteen harvests he accumulated several hundred thousand hu of grain, with rice costing a few cash per dou.

units.zh: 重熙間，改隗衍党項部節度使。
units.en: During the Chongxi era he was made military commissioner of the Weiyan Tangut tribes.
units.literal: During Chongxi he was transferred to Military Commissioner of the Weiyan Tangut tribes.

units.zh: 先是，築可敦城以鎮西域。
units.en: Previously Kedun City had been built to secure the Western Regions.
units.literal: Previously Kedun City had been built to pacify the Western Regions.

units.zh: 諸部縱民畜牧，反招寇掠。
units.en: The various tribes allowed the people to pasture livestock freely, which instead invited raids.
units.literal: The various tribes allowed the people to pasture livestock, which instead invited raids.

units.zh: 重熙四年，上疏曰：「自建可敦城已來，西蕃數為邊患，每煩遠戍。
units.en: In the fourth year of Chongxi he memorialized, "Since Kedun City was built, the western tribes have repeatedly troubled the border, each time requiring distant garrisons.
units.literal: In the fourth year of Chongxi he memorialized: "Since Kedun City was built, the western tribes have repeatedly troubled the border, each time requiring distant garrisons.

units.zh: 歲月既久，國力耗竭。
units.en: As the years lengthened, the state's strength was exhausted.
units.literal: As years lengthened, state strength was exhausted.

units.zh: 不若復守故疆，省罷戍役。」
units.en: It would be better to hold the former borders again and reduce frontier garrison duty."
units.literal: Better to hold the former borders again and reduce frontier service."

units.zh: 不報。
units.en: There was no response.
units.literal: There was no response.

units.zh: 是年，致仕。
units.en: That year he retired from office.
units.literal: That year he retired.

units.zh: 乞勒其父屋質功於石，帝命耶律庶成制文，勒石上京崇孝寺。
units.en: He asked that his father Wuzhi's achievements be carved on stone; the emperor ordered Yelu Shucheng to compose the text, which was inscribed at Chongxiao Temple in Shangjing.
units.literal: He asked to carve his father Wuzhi's merits on stone; the emperor ordered Yelu Shucheng to compose the text, inscribed at Chongxiao Temple in Shangjing.

units.zh: 卒，年七十八。
units.en: He died at the age of seventy-eight.
units.literal: He died at age seventy-eight.

units.zh: 蕭朮哲
units.en: Xiao Paizhe
units.literal: Xiao Paizhe

units.zh: 蕭朮哲，字石魯隱，孝穆弟高九之子。
units.en: Xiao Paizhe, style name Shiluyin, was the son of Gao Jiu, younger brother of Xiaomu.
units.literal: Xiao Paizhe, whose style name was Shiluyin, was son of Gao Jiu, younger brother of Xiaomu.

units.zh: 以戚屬加監門衛上將軍。
units.en: By virtue of imperial kinship he was made general of the Gate Guards.
units.literal: By imperial kinship he was made General of the Gate Guards.

units.zh: 重熙十三年，將衛兵討李元昊有功，遷興聖宮使。
units.en: In the thirteenth year of Chongxi he led the guard troops against Li Yuanhao with merit and was promoted to director of the Xingsheng Palace.
units.literal: In the thirteenth year of Chongxi he led guard troops against Li Yuanhao with merit and was promoted to Director of the Xingsheng Palace.

units.zh: 蒲奴裏部長陶得裏叛，朮哲為統軍都監，從都統耶律義先擊之，擒陶得裏。
units.en: When the Punnuli chieftain Taodeli rebelled, Paizhe served as army superintendent and followed the commander-in-chief Yelu Yixian in the attack, capturing Taodeli.
units.literal: When the Punnuli chieftain Taodeli rebelled, Paizhe served as Army Superintendent and followed Commander-in-chief Yelu Yixian to attack, capturing Taodeli.

units.zh: 朮哲與義先不協，誣義先罪，免官。
units.en: Paizhe did not get along with Yixian, falsely accused him of a crime, and had him removed from office.
units.literal: Paizhe did not get along with Yixian, falsely accused him of crime, and had him removed from office.

units.zh: 稍遷西南面招討都監，坐事下獄，以太后言，杖而釋之。
units.en: He was gradually promoted to southwest pacification superintendent; for an offense he was imprisoned, but at the empress dowager's word he was beaten with the staff and released.
units.literal: He was gradually promoted to Southwest Pacification Superintendent; for an offense he was imprisoned, but at the empress dowager's word he was beaten with the staff and released.

units.zh: 清寧初，為國舅詳穩、西北路招討使，私取官粟三百斛，及代，留畜產，令主者鬻之以償。
units.en: Early in Qingning he was imperial uncle Details Steady and northwest pacification commissioner; he privately took three hundred hu of official grain, and on leaving office left livestock for the custodian to sell in repayment.
units.literal: Early in Qingning he was Imperial Uncle Details Steady and Northwest Pacification Commissioner; he privately took three hundred hu of official grain, and on leaving office left livestock for the custodian to sell in repayment.

units.zh: 後族弟胡睹到部發其事，帝怒，決以大杖，免官。
units.en: Later his clansman cousin Hudu came to the post and exposed the matter; the emperor was enraged, sentenced him to the great staff, and removed him from office.
units.literal: Later his clansman cousin Hudu came to the post and exposed the matter; the emperor was angry, sentenced him to the great staff, and removed him from office.

units.zh: 尋起為昭德軍節度使，徵為北院宣徽使。
units.en: Soon he was reappointed military commissioner of Zhaode Army and summoned as northern court palace commissioner.
units.literal: Soon he was reappointed Military Commissioner of Zhaode Army and summoned as Northern Court Palace Commissioner.

units.zh: 九年，上以朮哲先為招討，威行諸部，復為西北路招討使。
units.en: In the ninth year, because Paizhe had earlier served as pacification commissioner and his authority extended through the tribes, he was again made northwest pacification commissioner.
units.literal: In the ninth year, because Paizhe had earlier served as pacification commissioner and his authority extended through the tribes, he was again made Northwest Pacification Commissioner.

units.zh: 訓士卒，增器械，省追呼，嚴號令。
units.en: He trained the soldiers, increased weapons, reduced forced levies, and enforced strict orders.
units.literal: He trained soldiers, increased weapons, reduced forced levies, and enforced strict orders.

units.zh: 人不敢犯，邊境晏然。
units.en: No one dared offend him, and the border was tranquil.
units.literal: No one dared offend him; the border was tranquil.

units.zh: 十年，入朝，封柳城郡王。
units.en: In the tenth year he came to court and was enfeoffed as prince of Liucheng commandery.
units.literal: In the tenth year he entered court and was enfeoffed Prince of Liucheng commandery.

units.zh: 咸雍二年，拜北府宰相，為北院樞密使耶律乙辛所忌，誣朮哲與護衛蕭忽古等謀害乙辛。
units.en: In the second year of Xianyong he was appointed northern chancellery chancellor; Yelu Yixin, northern court privy commissioner, envied him and accused Paizhe of plotting with the guardsman Xiao Hugu and others to harm Yixin.
units.literal: In the second year of Xianyong he was appointed Northern Chancellery Chancellor; Yelu Yixin, Northern Court Privy Commissioner, envied him and accused Paizhe of plotting with guardsman Xiao Hugu to harm Yixin.

units.zh: 詔獄無狀，罷相，出鎮順義軍。
units.en: An imperial investigation found no substance to the charge; he was dismissed as chancellor and sent out to govern Shunyi Army.
units.literal: Imperial investigation found no substance; he was dismissed as chancellor and sent out to govern Shunyi Army.

units.zh: 卒，追王晉、宋、梁三國。
units.en: On his death he was posthumously enfeoffed as king of Jin, Song, and Liang — the three states.
units.literal: On death he was posthumously enfeoffed as king of Jin, Song, and Liang — the three states.

units.zh: 侄藥師奴。
units.en: His nephew was Yaoshinu.
units.literal: Nephew Yaoshinu.

units.zh: 藥師奴
units.en: Yaoshinu
units.literal: Yaoshinu

units.zh: 藥師奴，幼穎悟，謹禮法，補祗候郎君。
units.en: Yaoshinu was clever from childhood, careful in ritual and law, and was appointed attendant gentleman.
units.literal: Yaoshinu was clever from youth, careful in ritual and law, and appointed Attendant Gentleman.

units.zh: 大康中，為興聖宮使，累遷同知殿前點檢司事。
units.en: During the Dakang era he was director of the Xingsheng Palace and was repeatedly promoted to vice director of the Palace Front Inspection Office.
units.literal: During Dakang he was Director of Xingsheng Palace and repeatedly promoted to Vice Director of the Palace Front Inspection Office.

units.zh: 上嘉其宿衛嚴肅，遷右夷離畢。
units.en: The emperor commended his stern palace guard service and promoted him to Right Yilibi.
units.literal: The emperor commended his stern palace guard service and promoted him to Right Yilibi.

units.zh: 夏王李乾順為宋所攻，求解，帝命藥師奴持節使宋，請罷兵通好，宋從之。
units.en: When the Xia king Li Qianshun was attacked by Song and sought relief, the emperor ordered Yaoshinu to go as envoy to Song bearing credentials, asking that hostilities cease and friendly relations be restored; Song agreed.
units.literal: When Xia King Li Qianshun was attacked by Song and sought relief, the emperor ordered Yaoshinu to bear credentials as envoy to Song, asking cessation of hostilities and renewed friendship; Song agreed.

units.zh: 拜南面林牙，改漢人行宮副部署。
units.en: He was appointed southern forest ya and transferred to deputy commissioner of the Han traveling palace.
units.literal: He was appointed Southern Forest Ya and transferred to Deputy Commissioner of the Han traveling palace.

units.zh: 乾統初，出為安東軍節度使，卒。
units.en: Early in Qiantong he went out as military commissioner of Andong Army and died.
units.literal: Early in Qiantong he went out as Military Commissioner of Andong Army and died.

units.zh: 耶律玦
units.en: Yelu Jue
units.literal: Yelu Jue

units.zh: 耶律玦，字吾展，遙輦鮮質可汗之後。
units.en: Yelu Jue, style name Wuzhan, was a descendant of Khan Xianzhi of the Yaolian.
units.literal: Yelu Jue, whose style name was Wuzhan, was a descendant of Khan Xianzhi of the Yaolian.

units.zh: 重熙初，召修國史，補符寶郎，累遷知北院副部署事。
units.en: Early in Chongxi he was summoned to compile the national history, appointed credential bearer gentleman, and was repeatedly promoted to vice commissioner of the northern court deputy office.
units.literal: Early in Chongxi he was summoned to compile the national history, appointed Credential Bearer Gentleman, and repeatedly promoted to Vice Commissioner of the Northern Court Deputy Office.

units.zh: 入見太后，後顧左右曰：「先皇謂玦必為偉人，果然。」
units.en: On audience with the empress dowager, she looked back at those beside her and said, "The former emperor said Jue would surely prove a great man — and so it has come to pass."
units.literal: On audience with the empress dowager, she looked back at those beside her and said: "The former emperor said Jue would surely be a great man — and so it proves."

units.zh: 除樞密副使，出為西南面招討都監，歷同簽南京留守事、南面林牙。
units.en: He was made vice privy commissioner, sent out as southwest pacification superintendent, and successively served as co-signatory of the Nanjing military governorship and southern forest ya.
units.literal: He was made Vice Privy Commissioner, sent out as Southwest Pacification Superintendent, and successively served as Co-signatory of Nanjing Military Governorship and Southern Forest Ya.

units.zh: 皇弟秦國王為遼興軍節度使，以玦同知使事，多所匡正。
units.en: When the emperor's younger brother the Prince of Qin was military commissioner of Liaoxing Army, Jue was made co-administrator of the commission and corrected many matters.
units.literal: When the emperor's younger brother the Prince of Qin was Military Commissioner of Liaoxing Army, Jue was made co-administrator and corrected many matters.

units.zh: 十年，復為樞密副使。
units.en: In the tenth year he again became vice privy commissioner.
units.literal: In the tenth year he again became Vice Privy Commissioner.

units.zh: 咸雍初，兼北院副部署。
units.en: Early in Xianyong he concurrently held northern court vice commissioner.
units.literal: Early in Xianyong he concurrently held Northern Court Vice Commissioner.

units.zh: 及秦國王為西京留守，請玦為佐，從之。
units.en: When the Prince of Qin became military governor of the Western Capital, he requested Jue as his assistant, and the emperor assented.
units.literal: When the Prince of Qin became Military Governor of the Western Capital, he requested Jue as assistant; the emperor assented.

units.zh: 歲中獄空者三，召為孟父房敞穩。
units.en: Within the year the prisons were empty three times; he was summoned as Details Steady of the Mengfu House.
units.literal: Within the year the prisons were empty three times; he was summoned as Details Steady of the Mengfu House.

units.zh: 玦不喜貨殖，帝知其貧，賜宮戶十。
units.en: Jue did not care for profit-seeking; the emperor knew he was poor and bestowed ten palace households on him.
units.literal: Jue did not care for profit-seeking; the emperor knew he was poor and bestowed ten palace households.

units.zh: 嘗謂宰相曰：「契丹忠正無如玦者，漢人則劉伸而已。
units.en: He once told the chancellor, "Among the Khitan none is so loyal and upright as Jue; among the Han, only Liu Shen.
units.literal: He once told the chancellor: "Among Khitan none is so loyal and upright as Jue; among Han only Liu Shen.

units.zh: 然熟察之，玦優於伸。」
units.en: Yet on close examination, Jue surpasses Shen."
units.literal: Yet on close examination, Jue surpasses Shen."

units.zh: 先是，西北諸部久不能平，上遣玦問狀，執弛慢者痛繩之。
units.en: Earlier the northwestern tribes had long gone unpacified; the emperor sent Jue to investigate, seized those who were negligent, and punished them severely.
units.literal: Earlier the northwestern tribes had long not been pacified; the emperor sent Jue to investigate, seized the negligent, and sternly punished them.

units.zh: 以酒疾卒。
units.en: He died of an illness brought on by wine.
units.literal: He died of wine sickness.

units.zh: 耶律仆里篤
units.en: Yelu Pulidu
units.literal: Yelu Pulidu

units.zh: 耶律仆里篤，字燕隱，六院林牙突呂不也四世孫。
units.en: Yelu Pulidu, style name Yanyin, was a fourth-generation descendant of Tulubu, forest ya of the Six Courts.
units.literal: Yelu Pulidu, whose style name was Yanyin, was fourth-generation descendant of Forest Ya Tulubu of the Six Courts.

units.zh: 開泰間，為本班郎君。
units.en: During the Kaitai era he was gentleman of the native company.
units.literal: During Kaitai he was Gentleman of the Native Company.

units.zh: 有捕盜功，樞密使蕭樸薦之，遷率府率。
units.en: For merit in capturing bandits, privy commissioner Xiao Pu recommended him, and he was promoted to colonel of the rate office.
units.literal: For merit in capturing bandits, Privy Commissioner Xiao Pu recommended him and he was promoted to Colonel of the Rate Office.

units.zh: 太平中，同知南院宣徽事，累遷彰聖軍節度使。
units.en: During the Taiping era he was vice commissioner of southern court palace affairs and was repeatedly promoted to military commissioner of Zhangsheng Army.
units.literal: During Taiping he was Vice Commissioner of Southern Court Palace Affairs and repeatedly promoted to Military Commissioner of Zhangsheng Army.

units.zh: 重熙十六年，知興中府，以獄空聞。
units.en: In the sixteenth year of Chongxi he governed Xingzhong Prefecture and became known for keeping the prisons empty.
units.literal: In the sixteenth year of Chongxi he governed Xingzhong Prefecture and became known for empty prisons.

units.zh: 十八年，伐夏，攝西南面招討使。
units.en: In the eighteenth year, on the campaign against Xia, he acted as southwest pacification commissioner.
units.literal: In the eighteenth year, campaigning against Xia, he acted as Southwest Pacification Commissioner.

units.zh: 十九年，夏人侵金肅軍，敗之，斬首萬餘級，加右武衛上將軍。
units.en: In the nineteenth year the Xia attacked Jinsu Army; he defeated them, took more than ten thousand heads, and was made general of the Right Martial Guard.
units.literal: In the nineteenth year the Xia attacked Jinsu Army; he defeated them, took over ten thousand heads, and was made General of the Right Martial Guard.

units.zh: 時近邊群牧數被寇掠，遷倒塌嶺都監以治之，桴鼓不鳴。
units.en: At the time the nearby border herds were repeatedly raided; he was transferred to superintendent of Daotaoling to remedy this, and the alarm drums fell silent.
units.literal: At the time nearby border herds were repeatedly raided; he was transferred to Superintendent of Daotaoling to remedy this, and the alarm drums fell silent.

units.zh: 二十年，知金肅軍事。
units.en: In the twentieth year he administered the affairs of Jinsu Army.
units.literal: In the twentieth year he administered Jinsu Army affairs.

units.zh: 宰相趙惟節總領邊城橋道芻粟，請貳，帝命仆里篤副之，以稱職聞。
units.en: Chancellor Zhao Weijie oversaw the bridges, roads, and fodder-grain of the border cities and requested a deputy; the emperor ordered Pulidu to serve under him, and Pulidu became known for performing his duties well.
units.literal: Chancellor Zhao Weijie oversaw border cities' bridges, roads, and fodder-grain; he requested a deputy; the emperor ordered Pulidu as second in command, and he became known for fitting his duties.

units.zh: 清寧初，歷長寧、匡義二軍節度使，致仕。
units.en: Early in Qingning he successively served as military commissioner of Changning and Kuangyi armies, then retired.
units.literal: Early in Qingning he successively governed Changning and Kuangyi armies as military commissioner, then retired.

units.zh: 咸雍間卒。
units.en: He died during the Xianyong era.
units.literal: He died during Xianyong.

units.zh: 子阿固質，終倒塌嶺都監。
units.en: His son Aguzhi ended his career as superintendent of Daotaoling.
units.literal: His son Aguzhi ended as Superintendent of Daotaoling.

units.zh: 論曰：韓八因帝微行，才始見售，及任以事，落落知大體，不負上之知矣。
units.en: The commentary says: Because the emperor went in disguise, Hanba's talent first found its opportunity; once entrusted with affairs, he broadly grasped the great principles and did not fail the emperor's recognition of him.
units.literal: Commentary says: Hanba, because the emperor went in disguise, had his talent first find its market; once entrusted with affairs, he broadly grasped the great principles and did not fail the emperor's recognition.

units.zh: 唐古、術哲經略西北邊，勸農積粟，訓練士卒，敵人不敢犯。
units.en: Tanggu and Paizhe administered the northwestern frontier, promoted farming and accumulated grain, trained the troops, and the enemy did not dare attack.
units.literal: Tanggu and Paizhe managed the northwestern border, urged farming and stored grain, trained soldiers, and the enemy did not dare offend.

units.zh: 玦以忠直見稱於上，仆裏篤以幹敏為宰相佐，在鎮俱以獄空聞。
units.en: Jue won praise at court for his loyalty and integrity; Pulidu was valued by the chancellor for his capability and keen judgment; and both became known in their regional commands for keeping the prisons empty.
units.literal: Jue was acclaimed by the emperor for loyalty and uprightness; Pulidu was valued by the chancellor for capability and keenness; both became known in their commands for empty prisons.

units.zh: 之數人者，豈特甲胄之士，抑亦李牧、程不識之亞歟。
units.en: Were these men merely soldiers in armor, or were they also the equals of Li Mu and Cheng Bushi?
units.literal: These several men — were they merely men of armor, or also the equals of Li Mu and Cheng Bushi?

units.zh: 用屋質之謀，各罷兵趨上京。
units.en: Following Wuzhi's counsel, both sides disbanded their armies and marched for the Supreme Capital.
units.literal: Following Wuzhi's plan, both sides disbanded their armies and marched for the Supreme Capital.

units.zh: 戊戌，皇子宗真生。
units.en: On wuxu day Prince Zongzhen was born.
units.literal: On wuxu day Prince Zongzhen was born.

units.zh: 耶律敵剌，字合魯隱，遙輦鮮質可汗之子。
units.en: Yelu Dila, whose courtesy name was Heluyin, was a son of the Xianzhi Khan of the Yaolian clan.
units.literal: Yelu Dila, courtesy name Heluyin, was a son of the Jianzhi Khan of the Yaolian clan.

units.zh: 己丑，皇子隆緒生。
units.en: On jichou day Prince Longxu was born.
units.literal: On jichou day Prince Longxu was born.

units.zh: 辛巳，以戶部使劉詵為樞密副使。
units.en: On xinsi day Household Commissioner Liu Shen was made associate privy commissioner.
units.literal: On xinsi day Household Commissioner Liu Shen was made associate privy commissioner.

units.zh: 冬十二月壬午，以知樞密院事楊績為南院樞密使，樞密副使劉詵參知政事。
units.en: On renwu day of the twelfth winter month Yang Ji, who administered Privy Council affairs, was made Southern Court privy commissioner; associate privy commissioner Liu Shen was made Associate Administrator of Affairs.
units.literal: Winter, twelfth month, on renwu day Yang Ji, who administered Privy Council affairs, was made Southern Court privy commissioner; associate privy commissioner Liu Shen Associate Administrator of Affairs.

units.zh: 十二月丁未，以參知政事劉詵為樞密副使，東北路詳穩高八南院大王，樞密直學士張孝傑參知政事。
units.en: On dingwei day of the twelfth month Associate Administrator of Affairs Liu Shen was made associate privy commissioner; Northeast Route detail-stable Gao Ba Southern Court great king; Privy Council academician Zhang Xiaojie Associate Administrator of Affairs.
units.literal: Twelfth month, on dingwei day Associate Administrator of Affairs Liu Shen was made associate privy commissioner; Northeast Route detail-stable Gao Ba Southern Court great king; Privy Council academician Zhang Xiaojie Associate Administrator of Affairs.

units.zh: 戊午，皇太叔重元與其子楚國王涅魯古及陳國王陳六、同知北院樞密使事蕭胡睹、衛王貼不、林牙涅剌溥古、統軍使蕭叠裏得、駙馬都尉參及弟術者、圖骨、旗鼓拽剌詳穩耶律郭九、文班太保奚叔、內藏提點烏骨、護衛左太保敵不古、按答、副宮使韓家奴、寶神奴等凡四百人，誘脅弩手軍犯行宮。
units.en: On wuwu day the imperial uncle Chongyuan with his son Prince of Chu Nielugu, Prince of Chen Chenliu, associate Northern Court privy commissioner Xiao Hudu, Prince of Wei Tiebu, linya Nielu Pugu, supreme commander Xiao Dielide, imperial son-in-law Can and his younger brother Muzhe, Tugu, drum-and-banner zhala detail-stable Yelü Guojiu, civil-class grand guardian Xi Shu, inner treasury intendant Wugu, Defender of the Left grand guardian Dibugu, Andada, deputy palace commissioner Han Jianu, Baoshennu, and others totaling four hundred men coerced crossbow troops to attack the mobile palace.
units.literal: On wuwu day the imperial uncle Chongyuan with his son Prince of Chu Nielugu, Prince of Chen Chenliu, associate Northern Court privy commissioner Xiao Hudu, Prince of Wei Tiebu, linya Nielu Pugu, supreme commander Xiao Dielide, imperial son-in-law Can and his younger brother Muzhe, Tugu, drum-and-banner zhala detail-stable Yelü Guojiu, civil-class grand guardian Xi Shu, inner treasury intendant Wugu, Defender of the Left grand guardian Dibugu, Andada, deputy palace commissioner Han Jianu, Baoshennu, and others totaling four hundred men coerced crossbow troops to attack the mobile palace.

units.zh: 己丑，以南院樞密使蕭阿速為北府宰相，樞密副使耶律乙辛南院樞密使，惕隱查葛遼興軍節度使，魯王謝家奴武定軍節度使，東京留守吳王貼不西京留守。
units.en: On jichou day Southern Court privy commissioner Xiao Asu was made Northern Court chancellor; associate privy commissioner Yelü Yixin Southern Court privy commissioner; tiyin Chage Liaoxing Army military commissioner; Prince of Lu Xiejianu Wuding Army military commissioner; Eastern Capital regent Prince of Wu Tiebu Western Capital regent.
units.literal: On jichou day Southern Court privy commissioner Xiao Asu was made Northern Court chancellor; associate privy commissioner Yelü Yixin Southern Court privy commissioner; tiyin Chage Liaoxing Army military commissioner; Prince of Lu Xiejianu Wuding Army military commissioner; Eastern Capital regent Prince of Wu Tiebu Western Capital regent.

units.zh: 以耶律乙辛知北院樞密使事。
units.en: Yelü Yixin was made to administer Northern Court privy affairs.
units.literal: Yelü Yixin was made to administer Northern Court privy affairs.

units.zh: 皇子洪基生。
units.en: The imperial prince Hongji was born.
units.literal: The imperial prince Hongji was born.

units.zh: 戊子，以殿前都點檢耶律義先為行軍都部署，忠順軍節度使夏行美副部署，東北面詳穩耶律朮者為監軍，伐蒲奴裏酋陶得裏。
units.en: On wuzi day, Yelü Yixian, commander of the Palace Front, was appointed supreme campaign commander; Xia Xingmei, military commissioner of the Zhongshun Army, was appointed his deputy; and Yelü Shuzhe, Northeastern xiangwen, was appointed army supervisor for the campaign against Taodeli, chieftain of Puniuli.
units.literal: On wuzi day, appointed Palace Front commander Yelü Yixian supreme campaign commander, Zhongshun Army military commissioner Xia Xingmei deputy commander, and Northeastern xiangwen Yelü Shuzhe army supervisor, to attack Taodeli, chieftain of Puniuli.

units.zh: 上曰：「昔元昊擾邊，宋終不能制，何也？」
units.en: The emperor said: "When Yuanhao once raided the frontier, Song could never bring him to heel—why was that?"
units.literal: The emperor said: "In the past Yuanhao harassed the border and Song could never control him—why?"

units.zh: 戊申，以耶律韓八為左夷離畢，特末裏為左祗候郎君詳穩，橫帳郎君樂古權右祗候郎君祥穩。
units.en: On wushen day Yelü Hanba was appointed Left yilibi; Temuli was made Left Assistant Attendant langjun xiangwen; and Cross-Tent langjun Yegu acting Right Assistant Attendant langjun xiangwen.
units.literal: On wushen day, made Yelü Hanba Left yilibi, Temuli Left Assistant Attendant langjun xiangwen, and Cross-Tent langjun Yegu acting Right Assistant Attendant langjun xiangwen.

units.zh: 丁酉，上率百僚冊上皇太后尊號曰睿德神略應運啟化承天皇太后；
units.en: On dingyou day the Emperor led the hundred officials in conferring on the Empress Dowager the honorific Sagacious Virtue, Divine Strategy, Responsive to Fortune, Initiating Transformation, Upholding Heaven Empress Dowager;
units.literal: On dingyou day the Emperor led the hundred officials to confer on the Empress Dowager the honorific title Sagacious Virtue, Divine Strategy, Responsive to Fortune, Initiating Transformation, Upholding Heaven Empress Dowager;

units.zh: 丁酉，胡裏室橫突韓德讓墮馬，皇太后怒，殺之。
units.en: On dingyou day Hulishi galloped across Han Derang's path and caused him to fall from his horse; enraged, the Empress Dowager had him executed.
units.literal: On dingyou day Hulishi charged across and startled Han Derang's horse so that he fell; the Empress Dowager was angry and killed him.

units.zh: 丁酉，皇太后幸韓德讓帳，厚加賞賚，命從臣分朋雙陸以盡歡。
units.en: On dingyou day the Empress Dowager visited Han Derang's camp, lavished rewards on him, and had attending ministers divide into teams for backgammon to celebrate.
units.literal: On dingyou day the Empress Dowager visited Han Derang's tent, richly rewarded him, and ordered attending ministers to divide into teams for backgammon to fully enjoy themselves.

units.zh: 戊子，賜於越宋國王紅珠筋線，命入內神帳行再生禮，皇太后賜物甚厚。
units.en: On wuzi day yuyue Song King was granted red pearl thread and ordered to enter the inner spirit tent to perform the rebirth rite; the Empress Dowager gave lavish gifts.
units.literal: On wuzi day yuyue Song King was granted red pearl thread and ordered to enter the inner spirit tent to perform the rebirth rite; the Empress Dowager granted gifts in great abundance.

units.zh: 太后豈不驚懼？
units.en: Would the Empress Dowager not be alarmed and afraid?
units.literal: Would the Empress Dowager not be alarmed and afraid?

units.zh: 皇太后謁奇首可汗廟。
units.en: The Empress Dowager visited the Qishou Khagan temple.
units.literal: The Empress Dowager visited the Qishou Khagan temple.

units.zh: 是日，帝與皇太后謁景宗皇帝廟。
units.en: That same day the Emperor and Empress Dowager visited Emperor Jingzong's temple.
units.literal: That same day the Emperor and Empress Dowager visited Emperor Jingzong's temple.

units.zh: 咸雍中，會有告餘里也與族人術哲謀害耶律乙辛，按無狀，出為寧遠軍節度使。
units.en: During Xianyong someone reported that Yulili and his kinsman Shuzhe had plotted to kill Yelü Yixin; the inquiry found nothing, and he was sent out as military commissioner of the Ningyuan Army.
units.literal: During Xianyong, there was a report that Yulili and his clansman Shuzhe plotted to kill Yelü Yixin; investigation found no substance, and he was sent out as military commissioner of Ningyuan Army.

units.zh: 蕭餘里也，字訛都碗，國舅阿剌次子。
units.en: Xiao Yulili, whose style name was Eduowan, was the second son of State Uncle Ala.
units.literal: Xiao Yulili, style name Eduowan, was the second son of State Uncle Ala.

units.zh: 夏國王李乾順。
units.en: The King of Xia was Li Qianshun.
units.literal: The king of the Xia state was Li Qianshun.

units.zh: 天會二年三月，乾順遣把裏公亮等來上誓表，曰：「臣乾順言：今月十五日，西南、西北兩路都統遣左諫議大夫王介儒等齎牒奉宣，若夏國追悔前非，捕送遼主，立盟上表，仍依遼國舊制及賜誓詔，將來或有不虞，交相救援者。
units.en: In the third month of Tianhui 2, Qianshun dispatched Bali Gongliang and others with the sworn memorial: "Your subject Qianshun reports: On the fifteenth of this month Wang Jieru, Left Remonstrating Grandee, and others bearing documents from the Southwest and Northwest circuit commanders announced that if Xia repents its past offenses, captures and delivers the Liao emperor, seals alliance in writing, and keeps to the old Liao protocols and the sworn edict Jin has granted, then in any future emergency we shall aid each other.
units.literal: In the third month of the second year of Tianhui, Qianshun sent Bali Gongliang and others to present the sworn memorial, saying: "Your subject Qianshun submits: On the fifteenth of this month the commanders of the Southwest and Northwest circuits, Left Remonstrating Grandee Wang Jieru and others, delivered an edict proclaiming that if the Xia state repents its former errors, captures and sends the Liao sovereign, establishes alliance and submits a memorial, and still follows the old Liao system and the bestowed sworn edict, then should anything unforeseen arise in future, we shall rescue one another.

units.zh: 於是，宋人與夏人俱受山西地，宋人侵取之，乾順遣使表謝賜誓詔、並論宋所侵地。
units.en: Song and Xia had both received Shanxi territories, but Song seized portions of Xia's share. Qianshun sent envoys to thank Jin for the sworn edict and to protest Song's encroachments.
units.literal: Thereupon both Song and Xia received Shanxi lands; the Song encroached and seized them. Qianshun sent envoys with a memorial thanking them for the bestowed sworn edict and also addressing the lands the Song had encroached upon.

units.zh: 太宗使王阿海、楊天吉往賜誓詔曰：「維天會二年歲次甲辰，閏三月戊寅朔，皇帝賜誓詔于夏國王乾順：先皇帝誕膺駿命，肇啟鴻圖，而卿國據夏台，境連遼右，以效力於昏主，致結釁于王師。
units.en: Emperor Taizong sent Wang Ahai and Yang Tianji to deliver the sworn edict: "In Tianhui 2, year jiachen, on the first day of the intercalary third month, the Emperor bestows this sworn edict upon Xia King Qianshun: The late emperor received Heaven's mandate and founded our great enterprise, yet your state holds Xia Terrace on Liao's western border, serving a deluded sovereign and thereby drawing Our armies into war.
units.literal: Emperor Taizong sent Wang Ahai and Yang Tianji to bestow the sworn edict, saying: "In the second year of Tianhui, cyclical year jiachen, the first day of the intercalary third month wuyin, the Emperor bestows this sworn edict on Xia King Qianshun: The former emperor received the glorious mandate and opened the great enterprise, yet your state occupies Xia Terrace, its border joining Liao's western flank, serving the benighted sovereign and thereby provoking enmity with Our armies.

units.zh: 天輔六年，金破遼兵，遼主走陰山，夏將李良輔將兵三萬來救遼，次天德境野穀。
units.en: In the sixth year of Tianfu (1122), Jin routed the Liao armies and the Liao emperor fled toward the Yin Mountains. Xia general Li Liangfu marched thirty thousand troops to Liao's aid and camped at Yegu on the Tiande frontier.
units.literal: In the sixth year of Tianfu, Jin defeated Liao troops; the Liao sovereign fled to the Yin Mountains. The Xia general Li Liangfu led thirty thousand men to rescue Liao, halting at Yegu in the Tiande borderlands.

units.zh: 天會二年，始奉誓表，以事遼之禮稱籓，請受割賜之地。
units.en: In the second year of Tianhui (1124), they first submitted a sworn memorial, accepted vassal status on the Liao model, and asked to receive the territories Jin was granting them.
units.literal: In the second year of Tianhui they first submitted a sworn memorial, took vassal status in the manner of their service to Liao, and requested the lands granted by partition.

units.zh: 臣與遼國世通姻契，名系籓臣，輒為援以啟端，曾犯威而結釁。
units.en: My house and Liao have been joined by marriage for generations; I was registered as Liao's vassal, yet I took arms as their ally, offending your Majesty and inviting war.
units.literal: Your subject and the Liao state have been linked by marriage for generations; by title your subject was a vassal, yet acting as their ally opened hostilities and offended Majesty to forge enmity.

units.zh: 既速違天之咎，果罹敗績之憂。
units.en: I soon drew Heaven's punishment and suffered crushing defeat.
units.literal: Having swiftly incurred Heaven's wrath, I indeed suffered the anguish of defeat.

units.zh: 蒙降德音以寬前罪，仍賜土地用廣籓籬，載惟含垢之恩，常切戴天之望。
units.en: Your gracious edict pardoned my earlier crimes and granted lands to widen my frontier—an indulgence I hold in awe, with gratitude as deep as for life itself.
units.literal: I was favored with a gracious edict to pardon former offenses and was moreover granted lands to broaden the vassal barrier; I bear deeply in mind this grace of swallowing shame and am ever keenly mindful of gratitude bound to Heaven.

units.zh: 自今已後，凡于歲時朝賀、貢進表章、使人往復等事，一切永依臣事遼國舊例。
units.en: Henceforth seasonal audiences, tribute memorials, and all exchange of envoys shall forever follow the customs of my service to Liao.
units.literal: From this day forward, in all matters of seasonal court congratulations, tribute and memorials, and envoys coming and going, everything shall forever follow the old precedent of your subject's service to Liao.

units.zh: 其契丹昏主今不在臣境，至如奔竄到此，不復存泊，即當執獻。
units.en: The deluded Khitan emperor is not within my realm; should he flee here, I will not shelter him but will seize and deliver him at once.
units.literal: The benighted Liao Khitan ruler is not now within your subject's borders; should he flee and arrive here, he shall not be harbored but at once be seized and presented.

units.zh: 若大朝知其所在，以兵追捕，無敢為地及依前援助。
units.en: If the Great Court learns his whereabouts and sends troops in pursuit, I will neither give him refuge nor aid him as I did before.
units.literal: If the Great Court knows where he is and pursues him with troops, I dare not provide territory for refuge or aid him as before.

units.zh: 其或徵兵，即當依應。
units.en: Should you call upon my forces, I will answer the summons.
units.literal: Should troops be levied, I shall respond accordingly.

units.zh: 至如殊方異域朝覲天闕，合經當國道路，亦不阻節。
units.en: Foreign realms paying court at the capital, if their route crosses my land, shall pass without hindrance.
units.literal: As for distant regions paying court at the heavenly gate, if they must pass through your subject's territory, passage shall not be impeded.

units.zh: 以上所敘數事，臣誓固此誠，傳嗣不變，苟或有渝，天地鑒察，神明殛之，禍及子孫，不克享國。」
units.en: On all the points above I swear this oath for myself and my heirs; should I break it, may Heaven and Earth bear witness, the spirits destroy me, calamity fall on my descendants, and my line lose the throne."
units.literal: In regard to the several matters set forth above, your subject swears this sincerity firm; it shall be transmitted to heirs without change—if there be any breach, may Heaven and Earth witness, may the spirits strike me down, may disaster reach my descendants, and may I not long enjoy the state."

units.zh: 宗望至陰山，以便宜與夏國議和，其書曰：「奉詔有之：夏王，遼之自出，不渝終始，危難相救。
units.en: Zongwang reached the Yin Mountains and, acting on his own authority, opened peace talks with Xia. His letter read: "By imperial command: Xia King—you were born of Liao's own line and have stood firm from beginning to end, rescuing each other in peril.
units.literal: Zongwang reached the Yin Mountains and, exercising discretionary authority, negotiated peace with the Xia state. His letter said: "By imperial order: Xia King—you sprang from Liao itself and have not wavered from first to last, aiding one another in hardship.

units.zh: 國舅、郡王高九。
units.en: Gao Jiu, Imperial Uncle and Prince of the Commandery.
units.literal: Imperial Uncle, Prince of the Commandery Gao Jiu.

units.zh: 國舅族，不知世次
units.en: Imperial Uncle clan; generation unknown
units.literal: Imperial Uncle clan; generation unknown

units.zh: 以宰臣劉晟監修國史，牛璘為彰國軍節度使，蕭孝穆為西北路招討使。
units.en: Grand Chancellor Liu Sheng was put in charge of compiling the National History; Niu Lin was made military commissioner of Zhangguo Army; and Xiao Xiaomu was made Northwestern Road pacification commissioner.
units.literal: Grand Chancellor Liu Sheng was put in charge of compiling the National History; Niu Lin was made military commissioner of Zhangguo Army; Xiao Xiaomu was made Northwestern Road pacification commissioner.

units.zh: 丙子，以西北路招討都監蕭孝穆為北府宰相。
units.en: On bingzi day Northwestern Road pacification surveillance commissioner Xiao Xiaomu was appointed Northern Court Grand Chancellor.
units.literal: On bingzi day Northwestern Road pacification surveillance commissioner Xiao Xiaomu was made Northern Court Grand Chancellor.

units.zh: 及蕭合卓、蕭樸相繼為樞密使，專尚吏才，始自聽訟。
units.en: When Xiao Hezhuo and Xiao Pu successively served as commissioners, prizing administrative talent, they began hearing lawsuits themselves.
units.literal: When Xiao Hezhuo and Xiao Pu succeeded one another as Commissioners of the Bureau of Military Affairs, valuing administrative talent exclusively, they began to hear lawsuits themselves.

units.zh: 興宗即位，欽哀皇后始得志，昆弟專權。
units.en: When Xingzong came to the throne, Empress Dowager Qin'ai finally had her way, and her brothers seized control of the government.
units.literal: When Emperor Xingzong took the throne, Empress Dowager Qin'ai at last had her way, and her brothers monopolized power.

units.zh: 馮家奴等希欽哀意，誣蕭浞卜等謀反，連及嫡後仁德皇后。
units.en: Feng Jianu and others, eager to please Qin'ai, framed Xiao Hubu and his associates for treason and dragged in the legitimate empress, Ren'ade.
units.literal: Feng Jianu and others, courting Qin'ai's favor, falsely accused Xiao Hubu and others of plotting rebellion, implicating the legitimate empress Ren'ade.

units.zh: 欽哀後謀廢立，遷於慶州。
units.en: When Qin'ai plotted to depose the emperor and enthrone another, she was banished to Qingzhou.
units.literal: Empress Dowager Qin'ai plotted deposition and enthronement, and was transferred to Qingzhou.

units.zh: 郡王貼不家奴彌裏吉告其主言涉怨望，鞫之無驗，當反坐，以欽哀皇后裏言，竟不加罪，亦不斷付其主，僅籍沒焉。
units.en: Miliji, a slave of Prince Junwang Tiebu, accused his master of disloyal speech; the charge could not be proved and the accuser should have been punished in turn, but at Qin'ai's private word he escaped punishment, was not returned to his master, and only had his property confiscated.
units.literal: The household slave Miliji of Prince Junwang Tiebu reported his master for words suggesting resentment; interrogation found no proof, and by law the accuser should be punished in turn; because of Empress Dowager Qin'ai's private word, he was in the end not punished, nor adjudged and returned to his master — only his property was registered for confiscation.

units.zh: 寧遠軍節度使蕭白強掠烏古敵烈都詳穩敵魯之女為妻，亦以後言免死，杖而奪其官。
units.en: Xiao Bai, commissioner of Ningyuan Army, forcibly took Dile's daughter as his wife; he too was spared death on the empress's word, beaten, and dismissed from office.
units.literal: Xiao Bai, military commissioner of Ningyuan Army, forcibly seized the daughter of Dile, detailed commander of the Uighur and Tatar tribes, as wife; he too was spared death on the empress's word, beaten, and stripped of office.

units.zh: 重熙元年，詔職事官公罪聽贖，私罪各從本法；
units.en: In the first year of Chongxi, an edict allowed functional officials to redeem public offenses, while private offenses were punished under the usual statutes;
units.literal: In the first year of Chongxi, an edict stated that functional officials' public offenses might be redeemed, while private offenses were each punished according to the applicable statute;

units.zh: 及奉迎以歸，頗復預事，其酷虐不得逞矣。
units.en: When she was brought back to court, she again meddled in state affairs, but she could no longer carry out her cruelties at will.
units.literal: When she was escorted back in welcome, she again took part in affairs to a considerable degree, yet her cruelty could no longer be indulged.

units.zh: 樞密副使胡睹。
units.en: Hudu, Privy Vice Commissioner.
units.literal: Privy Vice Commissioner Hudu.

units.zh: 宰相撻列。
units.en: Talie, Chancellor.
units.literal: Chancellor Talie.

units.zh: 興宗仁懿皇后父孝穆
units.en: Xiaomu, father of Empress Renyi, consort of Emperor Xingzong
units.literal: Father of Emperor Xingzong's Empress Renyi, Xiaomu

units.zh: 時西蕃多叛，上欲為守禦計，命耶律唐古督耕稼以給西軍。
units.en: With many western tribes in rebellion, the emperor sought to strengthen frontier defenses and ordered Yelü Tanggu to supervise farming to supply the western armies.
units.literal: At that time the western tribes rebelled in great numbers; the emperor wished to plan for defense and ordered Yelü Tanggu to supervise farming to supply the western army.

units.zh: 唐古率眾田臚朐河側，歲登上熟。
units.en: Tanggu led his men to farm along the Luju River, and year after year they reaped abundant harvests.
units.literal: Tanggu led the multitude to farm along the Luju River, and each year they achieved abundant harvests.

units.zh: 移屯鎮州，凡十四稔，積粟數十萬斛，每鬥不過數錢。
units.en: He then moved his encampment to Zhenzhou; over fourteen harvests he accumulated several hundred thousand hu, and grain sold for only a few cash per dou.
units.literal: He moved his encampment to Zhenzhou; over fourteen harvests he accumulated several hundred thousand hu of grain, and each dou cost no more than a few cash.

units.zh: 道宗初年，西北雨穀三十里，春州斗粟六錢。
units.en: Early in the Daozong Emperor's reign, grain reportedly rained across thirty li in the northwest, and at Chunzhou a dou of grain sold for six cash.
units.literal: In the early years of the Daozong Emperor, in the northwest grain rained for thirty li, and at Chunzhou a dou of grain cost six cash.

units.zh: 己未，以中京留守韓資讓知樞密院事，同知南院樞密使事蕭藥師奴知右夷離畢。
units.en: On jiwei day Central Capital regent Han Zirang was made administrator of Privy Council affairs; associate Southern Court privy commissioner Xiao Yaoshinu administrator of Right yilibi affairs.
units.literal: On jiwei day Central Capital regent Han Zirang was made administrator of Privy Council affairs; associate Southern Court privy commissioner Xiao Yaoshinu administrator of Right yilibi affairs.

units.zh: 十一月乙巳朔，知右夷離畢事蕭藥師奴、樞密直學士耶律儼使宋，諷與夏和。
units.en: On the yisi new moon of the eleventh month administrator of Right yilibi affairs Xiao Yaoshinu and privy council academician Yelü Yan were sent to Song to advise harmony with Xia.
units.literal: Eleventh month, on yisi new moon, administrator of Right yilibi affairs Xiao Yaoshinu and privy council academician Yelü Yan were sent to Song to advise harmony with Xia.

units.zh: 六月甲申，以奚六部大王回離保為契丹行宮都部署，知右夷離畢事蕭藥師奴南面林牙，兼知契丹行宮都部署事。
units.en: On jiashen day of the sixth month Xi Six Divisions great king Huilibao was made Khitan mobile palace deployment director; administrator of Right yilibi affairs Xiao Yaoshinu Southern Court palace academician and also administrator of Khitan mobile palace affairs.
units.literal: Sixth month, on jiashen day Xi Six Divisions great king Huilibao was made Khitan mobile palace deployment director; administrator of Right yilibi affairs Xiao Yaoshinu Southern Court palace academician and also administrator of Khitan mobile palace affairs.

units.zh: 夏五月壬戌，藥師奴等使宋回，奏宋罷兵。
units.en: On renxu day of the fifth summer month Yaoshinu and others returned from Song and memorialized that Song had ceased hostilities.
units.literal: Summer, fifth month, on renxu day Yaoshinu and others returned from Song and memorialized that Song had ceased hostilities.

units.zh: 昔李牧之為趙將也，北翦胡寇，西卻秦軍，郭開譖之，牧死趙滅。
units.en: Long ago, when Li Mu served Zhao as general, he cut down the northern raiders and drove back the armies of Qin. Guo Kai slandered him; Li Mu died, and Zhao was destroyed.
units.literal: Long ago, when Li Mu served Zhao as general, he cut down the northern raiders and drove back the armies of Qin — Guo Kai slandered him; Li Mu died, and Zhao was destroyed.

units.zh: 夏四月己巳，以興平公主薨，遣北院承旨耶律庶成持詔問夏國王李元昊，公主生與元昊不睦，沒，詰其故。
units.en: On jisi day of the fourth summer month, because Princess Xingping had died, Northern Court recipient Yelü Shucheng was dispatched with an edict to question Xia King Li Yuanhao, as the Princess had been at odds with Yuanhao in life and the reason was to be demanded upon her death.
units.literal: Summer, fourth month, on jisi day, because Princess Xingping died, dispatched Northern Court recipient Yelü Shucheng with an edict to question Xia King Li Yuanhao; the Princess had been at odds with Yuanhao in life, and in death the reason was demanded.

units.zh: 耶律玦，重熙中同知遼興軍節度使事。
units.en: Yelu Jue served in Chongxi as deputy acting Liaoxing Army military commissioner.
units.literal: Yelu Jue, in Chongxi was associate knower of Liaoxing Army military commissioner affairs.

units.zh: 會護衛蕭忽古謀害乙辛，事覺，下獄。
units.en: When guard Xiao Hugu plotted to kill Yixin, the plot was exposed and he was thrown into prison.
units.literal: It happened that guard Xiao Hugu plotted to kill Yixin; the affair was discovered and he was cast into prison.

units.zh: 乃與同知北院宣徽事蕭特裏特謀構陷太子，陰令右護衛太保耶律查剌誣告都宮使耶律撒剌、知院蕭速撒、護衛蕭忽古謀廢立。
units.en: He and Associate Commissioner of the Northern Bureau of Palace Attendants Xiao Telite then plotted to frame the crown prince, secretly ordering Right Guard Commissioner Yelü Chala to accuse Palace Director Yelü Sala, Commissioner Xiao Susa, and guard Xiao Hugu of plotting a coup.
units.literal: He then joined Associate Commissioner of the Northern Bureau of Palace Attendants Xiao Telite in plotting to frame the crown prince, secretly ordering Right Guard Commissioner Yelü Chala to accuse falsely Palace Director Yelü Sala, Commissioner Xiao Susa, and guard Xiao Hugu of plotting deposition and installation.

units.zh: 居久之，孝景崩，武帝立，左右以為廣名將也，於是廣以上郡太守為未央衛尉，而程不識亦為長樂衛尉。
units.en: Some time later, Emperor Jing passed away, and Emperor Wu ascended the throne. The Emperor's advisors considered Guang a renowned general, and so he was transferred from his post as Governor of Shangjun to become Commander of the Weiyang Palace Guard, while Cheng Bushi was made Commander of the Changle Palace Guard.
units.literal: Resided long time, Emperor Jing passed, Emperor Wu established, attendants considered Guang famous general, thereupon Guang with Shangjun governor became Weiyang guard wei, and Cheng Bushi also became Changle guard wei.

units.zh: 程不識故與李廣俱以邊太守將軍屯。
units.en: Cheng Bushi had formerly served alongside Li Guang as a border governor and garrison commander.
units.literal: Cheng Bushi originally with Li Guang both as border governors generals garrisoned.

units.zh: 程不識正部曲行伍營陳，擊刀鬬，士吏治軍簿至明，軍不得休息，然亦未嘗遇害。
units.en: Cheng Bushi, by contrast, maintained strict formations and encampments, posted sentries with watch clappers, and kept his officers working on military records until dawn. His troops got little rest, but he too was never taken by surprise.
units.literal: Cheng Bushi corrected divisions rows arrayed garrisoned, beat drums fought, officers officials managed army registers to dawn, army not got rest, but also never encountered harm.

units.zh: 是時漢邊郡李廣、程不識皆為名將，然匈奴畏李廣之略，士卒亦多樂從李廣而苦程不識。
units.en: At that time, Li Guang and Cheng Bushi were both renowned generals of the Han border commanderies. But the Xiongnu feared Li Guang's cunning, and the soldiers too preferred to serve under Li Guang, finding service under Cheng Bushi a hardship.
units.literal: At time Han border commanderies Li Guang, Cheng Bushi all were famous generals, but Xiongnu feared Li Guang strategy, soldiers also many happy followed Li Guang but suffered Cheng Bushi.

units.zh: 程不識孝景時以數直諫為太中大夫。
units.en: During the reign of Emperor Jing, Cheng Bushi had been appointed Grand Palace Master for his repeated candid remonstrances.
units.literal: Cheng Bushi Emperor Jing time with repeatedly straight advised became palace grand master.

units.zh: 為人廉，謹於文法。
units.en: He was a man of integrity who was scrupulous in his adherence to regulations.
units.literal: As person incorrupt, careful with written law.

units.zh: 不識曰：「李廣軍極簡易，然虜卒犯之，無以禁也；
units.en: Cheng Bushi said, "General Li Guang’s army is exceedingly loose and simple; if the enemy suddenly falls upon it, there is no way to restrain them.
units.literal: Cheng Bushi said, "General Li Guang's army is extremely lax, yet if the enemy suddenly attacks it, there is no way to stop them;
